## The claim

Genome-wide, no gene reaches a biallelic set only by rescuing a suppressed (non-PASS) coding call while also carrying a ClinVar pathogenic or LoF allele and a top-30 phenotype rank; in particular BUB1B carries no rare protein-altering non-PASS coding allele, so the BUB1B pair does not depend on a filter rescue and no rescued call adds a third BUB1B candidate.

**Prediction if true.** In results.gene_biallelic, BUB1B has n_nonpass = 0; every gene with biallelic_with_rescue true and biallelic_pass false either lacks a ClinVar pathogenic/LoF allele or has a phenotype rank worse than 30 (or no curation at all).

**What would refute it.** A rare protein-altering non-PASS coding allele in BUB1B, or a rescue-only biallelic gene with a pathogenic/LoF allele and a phenotype rank of 30 or better.
